profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: I am 10 years into the field of computer science and just as inspired by the work today as when I started. While that hasn't changed, I have grown a lot as a developer seeing best practices on massive projects serving millions of users and providing reliable, performant solutions. I have learned to work cross teams and manage complicated projects and take into consideration all parties concerned. My focus is on web development and most experience is in TypeScript and React, but all languages share the base capabilities and picking a new one up is a fun change of pace rather than a challenge. A common work day involves working in C#, Typescript, Powershell, KQL, and moving seamlessly between them all. As a developer for the Copilot team, every day is powered and supported by AI driven development and enjoy the opportunity to leverage it in supporting my productivity from parsing documentation to helping me quickly make edits after determining the proper fix.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Microsoft acquired Intentional Software and my team and I went on to develop Microsoft Whiteboard where I helped convert us to an SPA as we re-wrote our initial C# app in TypeScript with React. From there I worked on Teams integration of Whiteboard and deploying our app to compliant government clouds. The last project I worked on before our team transitioned to Copilot was cross-team integration of Loop features for faster collaboration.

In early 2024, I began working on Copilot and transforming Office.com. I helped establish the basic structure for us to come in and replace office.com, then added customer feedback support in a dynamic way that would support all our partner teams leveraging the page. From there I put in place our basic performance metrics so we could track our progress towards a reliable app. I once again helped deploy us to compliant government clouds and helped with the cross-team alignment of our feature rollout system.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Full-Stack Development · TypeScript · Single Page Applications · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Intentional is building an innovative software platform that will transform application development. We think all software should support real-time collaboration, natural input, rich game-like graphics, large datasets and intuitive UI, and be much easier to create as well!

positions.title: Computer Science Tutor
positions.description: I tutor students enrolled Principles of Computer Science and Introduction to Computer Science. This requires understanding and teaching assignments in Java, Python, Prolog, and Racket. In order to prepare for tutoring hours, I code the assignments earlier in the day to know what questions the students will ask.

positions.title: Autonomous Vehicles Head Tutor
positions.description: As the head tutor for Autonomous Vehicles, I assist freshman in assembling (soldering, milling, wiring, etc.) Arduino powered robots from scratch. After they finish building the robots, I help them with programming their boards to effectively use sensors for navigation and gold code detection (the signal emitted from the goal beacons). I was chosen for this position after creating a highly successful robot in the class my freshman year. My partner and I were the only group to use two boards which communicated in order to dedicate one board to driving and a second to sensing.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description: I worked with the Microsoft Word team to develop a feature for future release. The development process included analyzing legacy code structures, extensive coding in C++, writing unit tests for my feature, leveraging code review feedback, and managing code through versioning control tools

positions.title: Enterprise Business Architect Intern
positions.description:
While interning, I participated on two major projects: Enterprise Product Catalog and Knowledge Management. To assist with our implementation of the product catalog, I helped mapped the current and future state of the company; I assisted in designing the road map for integration; I played a significant role in gap analysis and the deep dive on the chosen product's capabilities.

For knowledge management, I led the march on uploading content to the central repository. Due to my efforts, the business architecture team was the first to have content available for use. I then went forth to create tutorial videos on how to use the program and take full advantage of the knowledge repository.

honors.title: First Team All-Conference
honors.description: I was recognized as a First Team athlete after winning the 800m in Track and Field at our conference meet. I proceeded to Nationals in Wisconsin where I was part of a 4x400m relay team to place 14th.
honors.issuer: Issued by Southern California Intercollegiate Athletic Conference · May 2013

honors.title: Western All-Region Athelete
honors.description: I was recognized for finishing in the top 35 of all athletes in the western region. Our team won the western region which qualified us for nationals where we had our best finish ever in school history taking 11th out of 35 teams.
honors.issuer: Issued by National Collegiate Athletic Association · Nov 2012
